    echo 'raw:', $double, ':', $mixed, ':', $outer, ':', $folded, '|';
}
function ordinaryPlus253($x) { return +$x; }
rawPlus253();
rawPlus253();
echo 'ordinary:', ordinaryPlus253(-0.0), '|';
purpose: Two Plus and mixed Minus/Plus chains preserve actual deferred +0/-0/+0 through cold/warm raw caches. Folded -0 and ordinary runtime +(-0) retain their separate phase.
